$description: Semantic component-token contract for Forge. Component tokens are the stable Figma variable names for visual decisions; values alias primitives or semantic theme tokens, with transparent surface slots retained where the component has no fill. Colour aliases resolve through the existing light/dark theme documents, light-dark(), and subtree theme pins. Structural formulas and behavior-only components remain local to their component.

component.$description: Figma variable collection: Mission Platform / Component. Use Light and Dark modes supplied by the semantic colour aliases.

button.$description: Button and icon-button contract. Variants are neutral, primary, secondary, tertiary, success, warning, info, error, critical, and ghost; sizes use 2xs through 2xl.

secondary.$description: Secondary button is an outlined treatment with a surface background and stronger border on hover.

tertiary.$description: Tertiary button is a transparent, low-emphasis treatment with semantic surface feedback.

ghost.$description: Ghost button has a transparent surface and uses semantic text colours.

icon-button.$description: Icon-button chrome; the icon glyph inherits currentColor and keeps its 1em local sizing.

input.$description: Text, textarea, date, number, search, phone, OTP, colour, and file controls. Sizes use 2xs through 2xl.

file.$description: ForgeFileInput browse button and dropzone roles; native input clipping remains structural.

location.$description: ForgeLocationInput fieldset and composed-coordinate state roles.

number.$description: ForgeNumberStepper button and field-specific roles; the shared input contract owns the wrapper states.

otp.$description: ForgeOtpInput cell surface, state, and canonical cell-size roles.

phone.$description: ForgePhoneInput composed country, dial-code, status, and validation roles.

search.$description: ForgeSearchInput affordance, clear-button, spinner, and size roles.

select.$description: Select and multiselect controls, including language and segment selectors.

segment.$description: ForgeSegmentControl container and selected-segment roles; width/layout behavior remains local.

checkable.$description: Checkbox, radio, switch, rating, slider, and range controls.

glyph-font-size.$description: Exact checkmark/minus glyph size used by the checkbox indicator.

inline.$description: Horizontal gap between control and label (radio, switch row).

stack.$description: Tight stacked gap (switch field column, rating stars).

duration.$description: Default checkable motion (radio/checkbox colour and indicator).

tag.$description: Compact tone labels and removable selection tags.

calendar.$description: ForgeCalendar surface, navigation, day-state, range-preview, and size roles. Grid geometry and date behavior remain local.

color-input.$description: ForgeColorInput wrapper, swatch, monospace value, state, and size roles.

time.$description: ForgeTimeInput and ForgeTimeRangeInput popover list and action roles.

form.$description: Shared visual contract for form-builder, form-wizard, and schema-form regions; drag/drop and layout behavior remain local.

field.$description: Shared form-field label, hint, error, field-set, builder, wizard, and schema-form regions.

field-set.$description: ForgeFieldSet frame, legend, description, and content spacing roles.

surface.$description: Cards, panels, separators, tables, lists, grids, stacks, masonry, timelines, and layout surfaces.

separator.$description: Separator line, label, and spacing roles.

quote.$description: ForgeQuote chrome. Text italics and composed typography variants remain local or are owned by ForgeTypography.

card.$description: ForgeCard surface, border, elevation, tone, and responsive padding variants. Container-query mechanics remain local.

overlay.$description: Alert banners, dropdowns, popovers, tooltips, toasts, drawers, dialogs, modals, and window popouts.

toast.$description: Toast typography and compact chrome; do not use dialog/modal-scale padding, radius, shadow, or surface values.

alert-banner.$description: Alert-banner-specific chrome. These compact values intentionally remain distinct from dialog and modal overlay chrome.

dropdown.$description: Compact dropdown panel chrome; dimensions and anchor positioning remain local.

popover.$description: Compact popover panel chrome; dimensions and anchor positioning remain local.

dialog.$description: Dialog surface and chrome; panel dimensions and native dialog behavior remain local.

modal.$description: Modal surface and elevation; panel dimensions and native dialog behavior remain local.

tooltip.$description: Compact inverse-tone hint panel — distinct chrome from the neutral overlay surface shared by dialogs/popovers/toasts.

drawer.$description: Drawer panel, backdrop, header/footer chrome, close affordance, resize handle, and enter/leave motion. Placement, dimensions, and drag mechanics remain local.

window-popout.$description: Inline popout wrapper, unavailable-content placeholder, and pop-in/pop-out toggle states. Browser-window lifecycle and content transfer remain local behavior.

feedback.$description: Badges, tags, status icons, progress, skeletons, spinners, and alert/status treatments.

badge.$description: ForgeBadge visual contract. Tone aliases preserve the original badge palette; size, gap, and radius slots cover the BEM variants while display and wrapping remain local.

progress.$description: Progress-bar track and fill roles. Fill aliases preserve the existing tone-to-theme mapping.

skeleton.$description: Skeleton placeholder fills, shimmer, and shape radii.

spinner.$description: Spinner foreground colors, size dimensions, radius, and available border widths.

status.$description: Status-icon foreground colors and size dimensions.

button-group.$description: Attached and detached button-group chrome. Flex direction, responsive gap formulas, border-radius collapsing, and focus stacking remain local.

collapse.$description: Native details disclosure surface, summary interaction states, content divider, disabled treatment, tone variants, and motion. Disclosure behavior and open-state rotation remain local.

navigation.$description: Breadcrumbs, menus, menu items, navbar, tabs, pagination, carousel controls, and navigation links.

navbar.$description: Navbar surface, responsive container spacing, mobile navigation chrome, and hamburger states. Sticky positioning and responsive visibility remain local.

navbar-item.$description: Navbar item and inline dropdown visual states. Dropdown positioning and viewport formulas remain local.

breadcrumb.$description: Breadcrumb trail text, separator, responsive spacing, and keyboard-focus chrome. Navigation layout remains local.

menu.$description: Menu panel, links, nested submenu chrome, and interaction states. Positioning and orientation remain local.

menu-item.$description: Standalone menu-item links and buttons. These slots preserve the compact menu-item geometry and feedback timing distinct from the menu panel links.

pagination.$description: Pagination button states, text, borders, focus, motion, and per-size typography. Control dimensions remain local custom properties to preserve the existing pagination scale.

carousel.$description: Carousel viewport, controls, indicators, autoplay affordance, focus states, tone accents, and motion. Slide measurement, transforms, pointer handling, and autoplay behavior remain local.

tabs.$description: Tab list, line/pill variants, close/add affordances, and panel spacing. Scrolling and tab measurement remain local.

menubar.$description: ForgeMenubar horizontal root, item links, nested submenu chrome, and interaction states. Recursive menu behavior, open-path state, and positioning remain local.

list.$description: List typography, item padding, separators, markers, and description-list spacing. Grid columns and responsive formulas remain local.

typography.$description: ForgeTypography, email typography, quotes, code, markdown, and content text. Named variants and interaction chrome are the canonical Figma roles; alignment, truncation, and anchor positioning remain structural.

theme-toggle.$description: ForgeThemeToggle focus indicator and label typography; button surface, border, spacing, and motion reuse the button contract.

icon.$description: All 106 icon glyph components inherit currentColor and consumer-controlled size. Do not create a token per glyph.

media.$description: Avatar, responsive image/video, background video, device mock, chat, and media surfaces.

avatar.$description: ForgeAvatar fallback fills, presence colours, outline roles, and independently configurable dimensions.

video.$description: Responsive video surface; sizing, aspect ratio, object-fit, and playback behavior remain local/native.

background.$description: Background-video content chrome; positioning and playback behavior remain local.

device.$description: ForgeDeviceMock frame chrome. Em-based dimensions and orientation geometry remain local so the size prop scales the complete device.

chat-area.$description: ForgeChatArea conversation surface, optional header/footer chrome, message-list rhythm, and responsive padding. Scrolling, auto-scroll, slot presence, and message rendering remain local.

chat-bubble.$description: ForgeChatBubble message rhythm, bubble chrome, typography, pending treatment, and primary variant. Avatar composition and message alignment remain local.

in-view.$description: ForgeInView demo content chrome. IntersectionObserver behavior and reveal animation styles remain local.

code.$description: Code block, Monaco, Mermaid, scanner, barcode, QR, and matrix-code rendering surfaces.

barcode.$description: ForgeBarcode wrapper rhythm. Bar and background colours remain API-controlled SVG properties so barcode scannability is not coupled to the theme.

scanner.$description: ForgeCodeScanner camera viewport, scan reticle, action rhythm, placeholder, and decoded-result chrome. Camera permissions, decoder integration, and square/layout formulas remain local.

virtual-log-viewer.$description: ForgeVirtualLogViewer log surface, filter toolbar, virtual row interaction chrome, columns, typography, and severity washes. Filtering, scrolling, row virtualization, and log formatting remain local.

debug.$description: Development-only diagnostic surfaces. These tokens describe visible debug chrome without implying runtime component behavior.

breakpoint.$description: ForgeBreakpointDebug fixed viewport badge. Its always-dark opaque surface preserves readable inverse text in both theme modes; viewport observation and breakpoint calculations remain local.

markdown.$description: Markdown document flow chrome. Typography of composed headings and paragraphs remains owned by ForgeTypography; these slots cover renderer-owned rhythm, links, quotes, rules, and images.

timeline.$description: Timeline marker, outlined state, connectors, orientation rhythm, and content spacing. Item order, alternating placement, and scroll behavior remain local.

editor.$description: WYSIWYG and Monaco editor chrome. Editing, scrolling, positioning, and third-party renderer behavior remain local; these slots expose editor-owned visual surfaces, states, and typography.

block-controls.$description: Per-block selection outline and floating alignment/move control bar.

block-menu.$description: Block-format trigger, menu panel, menu items, and keyboard/active states.

status-bar.$description: Compact editor statistics/status strip. Alignment and item content remain component behavior/layout.

toolbar.$description: WYSIWYG formatting toolbar and group separators; button interaction states are owned by ForgeButton.

monaco.$description: Monaco host container chrome; Monaco's own editor DOM and theme remain third-party/runtime behavior.

wysiwyg.$description: WYSIWYG editor shell and editable surface chrome.

map.$description: MapLibre host and child components. DOM-less map layers, sources, markers, and draw controls inherit the map host contract; third-party canvas pixels remain outside Forge CSS.

layout.$description: Container and layout templates expose inherited surface, text, spacing, and responsive structure tokens; grid formulas remain local.

grid.$description: ForgeGrid demo container and cell chrome; grid track formulas and inline layout styles remain local.

masonry.$description: ForgeMasonry demo item chrome; column flow, break safety, and dynamic gap calculations remain local.

hero.$description: ForgeHero responsive spacing and radius; alignment, media positioning, and content layout formulas remain local.

stack.$description: ForgeStack demo container/item chrome; the component's flex direction, gap, alignment, and sizing formulas remain local or inline.

application.$description: ForgeApplicationLayout shell chrome. Sidebar positioning, breakpoint behavior, dimensions, and stacking remain local; these aliases cover surfaces, separators, overlay treatment, status colours, status padding, and status motion.

data.$description: Data-dense Forge components. Table, tree, and virtualized list/table/tree contracts cover visual chrome only; scrolling, measurement, row positioning, and disclosure state remain component behavior.

table.$description: ForgeTable wrapper, loading state, header/cell rhythm, sortable affordance, row treatments, and tone variants. Native table layout, responsive breakpoint selection, and sorting remain local.

tree.$description: ForgeTreeView recursive tree typography, label row, focus/hover treatment, and disclosure toggle. Recursive rendering, depth, and open-map behavior remain local.

virtual-table.$description: ForgeVirtualTable custom footer demo chrome. Scroll virtualization, sticky header geometry, row sizing, and slot behavior remain local or inline.

virtual-list.$description: ForgeVirtualList Storybook row chrome. Scroll offsets, item height, and absolute positioning remain inline behavior.

virtual-tree.$description: ForgeVirtualTreeView flattened-tree typography, label row, focus/hover treatment, and disclosure toggle. Flattening, scroll window, depth indentation, and row measurement remain local.

resource-planner.$description: ForgeResourcePlanner visual contract for resource rows, timeline chrome, bookings, capacity status, and selection. Timeline sizing, scrolling, virtualization, drag/resize behavior, and resource data remain local.

scheduler.$description: ForgeScheduler visual contract for calendar grids, event cards, month/year views, and event-form rhythm. Calendar calculations, scrolling, drag/resize behavior, and event data remain local.

email.$description: Email components use the same semantic roles when translated to inline email CSS. Email clients do not consume runtime custom properties; the email renderer resolves this contract at generation time.
